ev.q: Of the 810 close contacts with known HIV status, 109 (13%) were HIV-infected
HIV-infected close contacts were less likely to be TST-positive than HIV-negative contacts or contacts with unknown HIV status
Of the 6225 close contacts, HIV status was unknown for 5415 (87%).
A median of 50 days passed before starting an HIV-positive contact on LTBI treatment compared with 33 days for HIV-negative contacts
Of the 30 HIV-positive contacts started on LTBI treatment, approximately half (14) completed treatment.
HIV-infected close contacts were less likely to be TST-positive than HIV-negative contacts or contacts with unknown HIV status
This study examined the clinic records of TB programs to determine whether these programs used recommended practices
because the study relied on existing clinic records, documentation of HIV status often was incomplete or nonexistent.
